sentences: Let's debug a small Python program in Neovim, step by step.
Space B C adds a conditional breakpoint. It only stops when number equals three.
Space B L adds a logpoint. It prints the value of doubled each time the line runs, without stopping.
Space B A lists both breakpoints.
Space D C starts the program. Pick Launch file.
It stops when number is three. The variables are on the left, and the logpoint output is on the right.
Space D K steps into the double function.
Space D O steps back out.
Space D J runs the next line.
Space D C runs to the end, and Space D T stops the debugger.
